raw_segments.text: France, fairest Cordelia, that art most rich, being poor, most choice forsaken, and most
Thee and thy virtues here I seize upon, be it lawful I take up what's cast away.
Tease strange that from their colds to neglect my love should kindle to enflammed respect.
Thy dourless daughter, king, thrown to my chance, is queen of us, of ours, and our fair
Not all the dukes of waterish burgundy can buy this unprised precious maid of me.
Bid them farewell, Cordelia, though unkind, thou loosest here a better where to find.
